rendering.sceneState: C# CPU Roslyn syntax/API-reference compile passed against Unity6000.6 assemblies. Shader compile, Unity import, .unity scene generation and runtime capture remain unverified.
rendering.implementationScope: Flat floor/wall with separate 512x512 teaching textures, impact-to-UV mapping, actual CPU texture stamps and camera orbit. Single-wall full-UV square illustrates (0.5,0.5). Production patent texture-atlas packing and automated general-mesh virtual-surface generation are omitted to isolate the mapping; no claim of shipping implementation or speed. Adjacent-region example uses two explicit coplanar Rect associations within the wall texture, with one-region versus combined update; general-mesh automation remains omitted.
rendering.assetChoice: The narrated objects are floor/wall surfaces, contact point and texture sheet. Author these geometry/data visuals directly; no unnecessary mannequin or vendor asset.
sceneReasons: Unity makes floor/wall orientation, ray contact, texture correspondence and camera orbit visible in one space.
